text: Autonomy mandate adopted as current orchestration discipline: do not trust push wake-ups; before going idle run plan state + plan in-progress, judge every in_review report, dispatch or park every pending task, and poll silent workers after 20 minutes. Current live focus is wake-on-report reliability in lane/wake-on-report-reliability; stale completed task records were reconciled. Loop record RPC is absent on this daemon, so loop_f585 closure evidence remains noted here for later reconciliation.
